title: Uppsala University Master’s Scholarships 2027

organization.name: Uppsala University
organization.about: Uppsala University is a comprehensive research university in Uppsala, Sweden, and the oldest university in the Nordic countries. Its research and education span science, medicine, technology, humanities and social sciences. Doctoral students are employed as paid researchers with monthly salaries across its departments.

deadlineText: Scholarship window 16 January - 1 February 2027; master’s application deadline 15 January 2027 via universityadmissions.se
intro: Tuition fee waiver scholarships for international master’s students at Uppsala University, Sweden.
description: Uppsala University Master’s Scholarships 2027 for the autumn 2027 intake include the Uppsala University Global Scholarship (full tuition fee waiver for one international master’s programme) and Anders Wall’s Scholarship (full tuition fee waiver for citizens of African countries, Bachelor’s or Master’s). Living expenses are explicitly NOT covered. Other categories may offer partial tuition waivers. The Global Scholarship is open to fee-paying students who are citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland; Anders Wall’s Scholarship is for citizens of African countries. Applicants must list the Uppsala University master’s programme as first priority on universityadmissions.se, complete the master’s application by 15 January 2027, and ensure the application fee and full documents reach the admissions office by that deadline. Some programmes are not eligible, including the Joint Nordic Master’s Programme in Environmental Law, Analytical Chemistry (EACH), Biodiversity (NABiS) and Euroculture. The scholarship application does not replace the master’s application: submit the master’s application by 15 January 2027 through universityadmissions.se, then the scholarship application during the 16 January to 1 February 2027 window. Living costs in Sweden are the applicant’s responsibility.
